actions.action: Spray tops and undersides of all leaves, stems and soil surface with dish soap solution (1 tsp per litre) weekly for 6 weeks
Buy blue sticky traps and place 2 in the pot
Count the thrips caught on the sticky traps weekly
Check soil moisture 5 cm deep before each watering
When dry, water until it drains and empty the saucer
Move the plant within 1 m of the window, out of direct midday sun

reason: The answer's main diagnosis is thrips plus low light, matching the confirmed problem, but it relies on a weaker soap spray instead of an insecticide like spinosad/celaflor and skips chop-and-prop, so the fix is only partial; nothing recommended is harmful.
